landing.metaDescription: Pomysłownik! connects university teams, laboratories, patent owners and startups across Poland. With sources and honest assessments.
landing.heroLead: Pomysłownik! connects university teams, laboratories, patent owners and startups across Poland. See who is working on what you are looking for, and how to reach them.

signIn.infoText: Cards are available after signing in. We protect the authors' intellectual property.

s1.title: Sign in and choose your role
s1.text: Your role sets the starting filters. You can change it in your profile.

s3.title: Check the sources and reach the team
s3.text: Every number has a source and a date.

login.intro: Sign in and choose your role to see the innovation cards. This protects the creators' intellectual property.
login.serverDown: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
login.demoNote: One click: a shared test account with real data.
login.testIdentityNote: Demo mode. Enter any identifier (e.g. “demo-anna”). This is not a login.gov.pl verification.
login.subject: Test identifier
login.subjectHint: 3–200 characters. Do not enter a PESEL number.
login.roleHint: Your role sets the default search filters. You can change it in your profile.
login.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> (no misuse of intellectual property) and the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.
login.contact: I agree to be contacted about matching innovations (optional).
login.heroLead: Universities, patents, laboratories and start-ups from all over Poland. With sources.

search.title: Find a Polish <hl>innovation</hl>
search.lead: Existing technological, educational and administrative solutions. Every value has a source and is marked as fact or estimate.
search.label: Search innovations
search.audiencesHint: Pick a group and we set its filters. You can change them on the results page.
search.mainAudience: Main audience: universities, laboratories and scientific institutions.
search.overviewNote: Data from the Pomysłownik database, current when this page was shown.
search.overviewError: We couldn't load the numbers right now. Search works as usual.
search.howStep1Text: We automatically collect existing Polish innovations from open sources: databases, university and institution websites, and documents.
search.howStep2Text: Every card has an implementation level, a TRL and scores. Every value is marked as a fact with its source or an estimate with its method.
search.howStep3Text: You search, filter and compare solutions, then go straight to the source and the owner.

results.emptyText: Try another word or <clear>clear the filters</clear>.
results.rateLimited: Too many requests at once. Please try again in {s} s.
results.pageEmpty: This page of results is empty.

card.trlOnlyTech: The TRL scale applies only to technological solutions.
card.alsoUsedInNote: Based on the description in the sources.
card.evidenceIntro: The numbers the scores were computed from. Each one has a source.
card.similarIntro: The closest cards in the database, most similar first. Similarity is computed from shared keywords and tags, not by the model. Every card describes a different solution, so even the closest matches are usually below 30%.
card.similarNone: No similar cards in the database.
card.historyNone: No status changes since it was first seen ({date}).
card.similarRank: {rank, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} closest in the database
